contentPattern.structure: circular avatar image + name (h3) + role/title + social links (per card)

suitableFor: team / contributor / author profile grids (round avatar + name + role)
'Our Contributors' and 'WKND Guides' style people grids
any centered grid of people with a circular photo and short caption
notSuitableFor: article/adventure teaser grids with rectangular images (use cards-teaser)
single side-by-side image + text feature (use columns-featured)

notes: NEW variant created for the section-landing template (about-us page). Based on the project's LOCAL cards block (does NOT import moveInstrumentation or fetchPlaceholders - compatible with this project's older aem.js/scripts.js). Renders each row as a centered card: a circular avatar image on top, then a body with name (h3) + role + optional social links. Classes scoped to cards-profile. Source cards are AEM 'contributor' experience-fragment components; the wknd-cleanup transformer flattens each to an image + name + role. DA project, so NO _cards-profile.json model file. Used for both the 'Our Contributors' (4-up) and 'WKND Guides' (3-up) grids on about-us.
